 사진 확대 BigBang. Photo: Screenshot from Mnet's 'MAMA Awards' The group BigBang made an appearance at the MAMA Awards while also winning an award.
 The Chapter 2 ceremony of the 2025 MAMA Awards was held at Kyocera Dome Osaka in Japan at 3 p.m. on the 21st.
 That day, BigBang won the Best Music Video with YouTube award for 'BiiiG,' released last August.
 Onstage to accept the award, G-Dragon and Daesung said, “Since this is an award for a music video, we'd like to thank the director and the many staff members,” adding, “We'd like to share this honor with everyone who watched the music video.”
 Taeyang, in particular, mentioned the Worldwide Fans' Choice award he received at the ceremony the day before and promised, “It's all thanks to our beloved fans. Thank you. We'll repay you with even better music and music videos.”
 BigBang, CORTIS, KiiiKiii, LE SSERAFIM, Nayeon, ZEROBASEONE, Hwasa, IVE, izna, Koi Kids, WOODZ and &TEAM will take the stage in Chapter 2. In Chapter 1, held the day before, the groups BTS and ENHYPEN took home the grand prize.
 The concept of this year's MAMA Awards is 'Music Interstellar.' On a journey that transcends time and space and sails among the stars of music, audiences will discover and experience unexpected, thrilling moments and the dazzling power of music in their own way. The concept offers the unique joy of finding one's own star while setting out a plan to create a mystical musical universe where artists and global fans connect across time and space through 'Music Makes One.'
 The ceremony is being broadcast live worldwide via major digital platforms, including Mnet Plus and TVING.
 Actor Park Bo-gum served as host for Chapters 1 and 2 and was named the MAMA Awards' first official ambassador.
 [Ji Seunghun, Star Today reporter]
